page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Hebrew words in section 82 are uncertain and marked [?]; the Hebrew before "Meni" and the two Hebrew forms after "pro" and "habet" were not read letter by letter. "requieviť" has a final letter read as t with a stroke, possibly a printing irregularity. Catchword "go," is the first word of the next page. Running head given as printed, without page number.
